description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule stash behavior. It defines functions to set up repositories with submodules, perform stash operations, and verify that changes in submodules are preserved correctly during stash and stash pop actions.

methods.name: git_stash
methods.description: Performs a series of Git commands to stash changes, including handling submodules, and applies the stash back.

methods.name: setup_basic
methods.description: Initializes a main Git repository and a submodule, commits initial files, and prepares the environment for testing stash operations with submodules.
